heading: Action for infringement of a patent containing an invalid claim

versions.heading: Action for infringement of a patent containing an invalid claim

lines.text: Whenever a claim of a patent is invalid, an action may be maintained for the infringement of a claim of the patent which may be valid. The patentee shall recover no costs unless a disclaimer of the invalid claim has been entered at the Patent and Trademark Office before the commencement of the suit.
